objects.name: Analytic 2279
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor process crashing unexpectedly, immediately preceded by an unusual cross-process memory access event from a process outside the recognized security/diagnostic tool allowlist. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=10 cross-process memory access into Industrial Control Systems (ICS) vendor process from image not in trusted security tool list, followed by unexpected termination within exploit crash correlation window

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window correlating a memory access event with a subsequent crash.
Allowlist of legitimate security/diagnostic tools authorized to perform cross-process memory access.
